obligations.name: Objects
obligations.constructed_input: The coefficient base is the actual y0 localization of the original contact-zero root base; the target order is its tensor base change of the original explicit three-root branch order. Both source maps originate from the original source principal open or actual infinity order, not independently chosen copies.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.constructed_input: Every one of the three remaining root factors participates in the denominator and twist product. New identities hold in the entire common integral ring and order, including nonreduced rings and characteristic two. Full finite-chart coverage still needs the previously explicit separation-unit condition, and complete arithmetic model coverage is not established here.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.constructed_input: All four unit twists are retained. The precise reciprocal coordinate is u=c0/y0, the differential factor is -(y0/u), the infinity powers are c0^-5 and c0^-4, and the common normalization is the original J². Actual denominator inverse identities justify cancellation.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.constructed_input: New compatibility proofs require only a commutative coefficient ring and unit twists. Native differential-frame and etale claims in predecessor modules retain their unit-two premise. No regularity, domain, or good-reduction assumption is silently added or inferred for bad places.

The final restriction consumer explicitly retains the chosen scheme routes and inclusion hypotheses.
